query: 供应商环境标准 供应商环境标准 衡量供应链环境准入标准与约束机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的供应商环境准入标准（含碳足迹、排污等硬性指标）；实行动态环境分级管理，并根据分级结果执行差异化采购政策；有明确的违规处理机制（如红线淘汰制）。 • 1分（合格）：发布了供应商行为准则，包含基础的环境保护要求，具备初次准入的环境审核，但缺乏动态分级管理或明确的违规退出机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无供应商环境标准披露，或仅笼统提及“推行绿色采购”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署环境协议或执行环境标准的供应商数量（或采购额）占比 >80%。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对一级供应商/关键原材料供应商执行，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商环境标准 绿色采购 供应商行为准则 环境准入 供应商环境审核 分级管理 环境黑名单 供应商退出机制 supplier environmental standards green procurement supplier code of conduct environmental prequalification supplier environmental audit tiered supplier management environmental blacklist supplier exit mechanism 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商环境标准'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“绿色采购”；仅有企业自身环境政策；仅有供应商劳工准则而无环境条款；仅有一次性供应商培训活动；区分：本指标聚焦供应链环境准入与约束；供应商行为准则可能同时含劳工与环境，需抽出环境条款；企业环境政策不等于已对供应商设硬性标准；道德采购更偏人权/合规采购。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Environmental, Social and Governance Report 2021 環境、社會及管治報告 2021 / Reduction of Environmental Footprint
results.text: 'Environmental Protection' is a traditional part of China SCE's 'Walk for Good' event. This year, together with China SCE's 4 th 'Walk for Good', China SCE's public welfare initiated the 'Environmental Partnerships, Speak Up for the Earth'. Over 800 team members and staff used their own water bottles throughout the 11 stops across the country, refusing to use bottled water or canned sports drinks. At the same time, the team members worked together to simulate various environmental protection symbols and spread them to their friends on social media to let more people understand environmental protection knowledge. They also used biodegradable garbage bags to collect recyclable garbage for a demonstration of recycling at the end point. The measures above make the concepts of 'Low-carbon Green' and 'Traceless Travel' have a real impact on everyone.
results.retrieval_text:

Environmental, Social and Governance Report 2021 環境、社會及管治報告 2021 / Reduction of Environmental Footprint

[Content]
'Environmental Protection' is a traditional part of China SCE's 'Walk for Good' event. This year, together with China SCE's 4 th 'Walk for Good', China SCE's public welfare initiated the 'Environmental Partnerships, Speak Up for the Earth'. Over 800 team members and staff used their own water bottles throughout the 11 stops across the country, refusing to use bottled water or canned sports drinks. At the same time, the team members worked together to simulate various environmental protection symbols and spread them to their friends on social media to let more people understand environmental protection knowledge. They also used biodegradable garbage bags to collect recyclable garbage for a demonstration of recycling at the end point. The measures above make the concepts of 'Low-carbon Green' and 'Traceless Travel' have a real impact on everyone.

results.section: Environmental, Social and Governance Report 2021 環境、社會及管治報告 2021 / Energy 能源
results.text: In order to reduce the carbon footprint and promote energy conservation, we have further strengthened the management of energy and resources in the office environment through five aspects: air conditioning management, lighting management, equipment and energy consumption management, water consumption management and management of office supplies and consumables, under the guidance of the 'Notice Regarding Workplace Energy Saving Measures'. Energy saving measures include providing guidelines on the conditions on using and temperature of air-conditioning, and reminding employees to switch off power-consuming equipment such as lighting, computers, air-conditioning and photocopiers before getting off work to minimise resource consumption. In addition, to keep up with market trends, the Group regularly reviews the energy consumption of electrical appliances, eliminates outdated products and purchases energy-efficient equipment to contribute to the development of a low-carbon economy.

Energy saving measures include providing guidelines on the conditions on using and temperature of air-conditioning, and reminding employees to switch off power-consuming equipment such as lighting, computers, air-conditioning and photocopiers before getting off work to minimise resource consumption.
